answer: Refundable work queue. Each new identity must complete paid micro-tasks before gaining full API access, and payment flows to a shared pool released only after a verification horizon of thirty days. If the identity is later proven sybil, its accrued refund is forfeited and the operator's linked payout address is docked the full amount plus a penalty, checked against a prisms of prior claims. This makes each fake identity cost the attacker real forfeited earnings plus penalty on their own payout pulse, scaling linearly with farm size.
